messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered — SLO p99 latency 5m burn detected for /v1/generate (region: us-east) — trigger=latency.p99 > 1200ms — paging eng-oncall
jordan: Acked in PD. I'm on it, switching to debug mode.
maria: I'm seeing a spike on nodes gpu-2a, requests queueing. Can someone check batching stats?
jordan: grabbing the batcher logs, tailing: ```[2026-03-15T14:12:34Z] batcher: dispatch_delay=340ms queued=12```
lee: noticed increased tail-latency for long-seq requests, possible KV cache thrash. Rolling KV warmup on pool-a
jordan: applying temp routing rule to divert 10% traffic to model-small variant to shed load — will monitor.
incident-bot: PD note: Alert acknowledged by jordan at 14:18 UTC
maria: customers on EU are unaffected, observed in us-east only. Impact: a subset of low-traffic users see slow responses. No errors.
lee: KV warmup done on pool-a, warming keys for common prefixes, eviction rate down.
jordan: reroute in place. p99 dropped from 1.6s -> 900ms in first 2m. continuing to monitor.
ops-bot: Running quick autoscale: requested +2 GPUs in us-east, expected up in ~3m
maria: can we keep canary at 10% for now, watch errors and tail latency? If stable, ramp up to 50%.
jordan: agreed. ramp plan: 10->30->50 over 10m if p99 < 1s and error rate < 0.1%
lee: tracking memory pressure — one node had OOM kills earlier, reprovisioned. No crashes now.
oncall-sre: If p99 creeps back above 1.2s, revert routing immediately and open PD escalation.
jordan: noted. I'll post updates every 3 minutes. Next in 3m.
maria: thanks. Adding a note to incident timeline and flagging customers with high latency.
jordan: 14:21UTC update: p95 180ms, p99 920ms, queue depth trending down. Keeping 10% diversion.
maria: :thumbsup: good signal. Leaving thread open until stable for 20m.
incident-bot: Auto-annotation: routing rule applied by jordan; autoscale request issued; KV warmup executed.
jordan: closing PD ack loop now, will re-open if autoalert fires again.
lee: follow-up: need to schedule a postmortem to look at KV eviction thresholds and batching hysteresis.
maria: created a follow-up task in PM board.
jordan: thanks all — handing back to ops rotation. :white_check_mark:
